svg.title: VPNs, proxies and load balancers: three kinds of middlemen
svg.desc: A VPN protects a path, a proxy speaks for one side, a load balancer spreads requests across many servers
svg.text: VPNs, proxies and load balancers: three kinds of middlemen
A VPN protects a path, a proxy speaks for one side, a load balancer spreads requests across many servers
VPN · a private tunnel across a public network
PROXIES · an intermediary that talks on someone's behalf
Squid · corporate web filter · secure web gateway
hides the SERVER · one front door
NGINX · HAProxy · Envoy · CDN · F5 XC edge
LOAD BALANCER · one address in front of many servers
VPN = encrypt a path between networks. Proxy = terminate the connection and re-open it for someone else.
Load balancer = a reverse proxy that picks a healthy backend, giving scale and resilience behind one address.
